name: EXXONMOBIL BAYTOWN REFINERY

reports_to_state.source: TCEQ Air Emission Event Report Database (STEERS), cached detail pages

reports.cause_excerpt: Severe inclement weather associated with January 2024 freeze event resulted in impacts to multiple units and associated equipment, resulting in emissions to atmosphere and safe utilization of the…
Furnace fire resulted in emissions to atmosphere.
EVENT IS BEING RETRACTED AS NON-REPORTABLE. PS-7 T-702 valve leak resulted in emissions to atmosphere.
Unplanned Hydrofining Unit 10 (HU-10) shutdown due to reactor (R-901A) bed temperature indication resulted in safe utilization of the flare system.
EVENT IS BEING RETRACTED AS NON-REPORTABLE. Pinhole leak on FCCU3 Regen Cat Standpipe resulted in emissions to atmosphere.
A pinhole leak resulted in elevated levels of benzene at the Wastewater Oxidation Unit and associated air emissions.
Unplanned Catalytic Light Ends (CLEU3) shutdown due to Propane Refrigeration Compressor (C-75) trip resulted in safety relief valves lifts to atmosphere and safe utilization of the flare system.
A leak at the sample point led to a benzene spill to soil with air emissions at OMCC. The spill led to elevated benzene levels at the BTRF Wastewater Treatment Plant and associated air emissions…
Inadvertent hydrocarbon ingress into the CLAUS plant resulted in emissions to the atmosphere from the Sulfur Conversion Unit 2 (SCU-2) Adsorber Effluent Desuperheater Tower (T-601) vent.
Incomplete combustion of CO in SG-501B boiler at FCCU3 resulted in elevated emissions at the wet gas scrubber.
Unplanned shutdown of Alkylation Unit (ALKY) due to a compressor (C-323) trip resulted in safe utilization of the flare system.
EVENT IS BEING RETRACTED AS NON-REPORTABLE. A malfunction of an emergency block valve (EBV 3649) resulted in safety relief valves lift to atmosphere.
While conducting required maintenance to replace thin piping, adjustments were made to the seal water level which resulted in interruption of make-up water to flare seal drum and safe utilization of…
A leak at Tank 352 Mixer resulted in emissions to atmosphere at Oil Movement Control Center (OMCC).
Catalytic Light Ends (CLEU3) Ethylene Refrigeration Compressor (C-74) trip resulted in emissions to atmosphere from Flare Stack 29 (FL29) and C-74 Knockout Drum (D-83) Rupture Disk Port Hole.
Unplanned shutdown of the Hydrofining Unit 10 (HU-10) due to a failed outlet valve on the Product Stripper Tower (T-901) bottoms resulted in safe utilization of the flare system.
Multiple Equipment Trips resulted in unplanned unit upsets, safe utilization of the flare system and emissions to atmosphere from equipment in SCU-2.

reports_to_epa.source: EPA Toxics Release Inventory via Envirofacts
reports_to_epa.note: Pounds per year, stack plus fugitive air releases; a null means the form gave no number.

caveats: Being upwind of a spike is not evidence of anything; wind at one monitor cannot tell facilities apart.
Reports listed here are what the facility reported to the state (TCEQ STEERS); amounts are the facility's own estimates.
TRI figures are what the facility reports to EPA each year for routine releases; they are estimates, not measurements, and not events.
